text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan Tambahan

Bagi Tahun 2019) 2020.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan tambahan bagi tahun 2019

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi enam ratus sebelas ribu

empat ratus ringgit (RM611,400) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial

Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan tambahan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2019 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 243,100

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 9,700

Perbelanjaan lain 358,600

Jumlah 611,400

Dibuat 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/27/6; PN(PU2)744/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

 SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (ADDITIONAL SUPPLY FOR THE YEAR 2019)

REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1)

of the Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Additional Supply For The Year 2019) Regulations 2020.

Issue for additional expenditure for the year 2019

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding six hundred and eleven thousand

four hundred ringgit (RM611,400) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for the

additional expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme

for the year 2019 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 243,100

Supplies and services 9,700

Other expenditures 358,600

Total 611,400

Made 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/27/6; PN(PU2)744/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
